{"reply": {"text":"We apologise for the inconvenience caused by the flickering and heat you are experiencing with your Lumen Flow Strip 5 m. As a result of the issue, we are issuing you a €15 store credit (1500 cents) which will be applied to your account shortly.

To address the immediate safety concern:
1. Cut the power to the strip and check the controller plug. If the flicker persists, the controller will be replaced under warranty.
2. If the controller feels hot to the touch, unplug the strip immediately and do not switch it on until it has been inspected.

Please let us know if you need any further assistance.","citations":[{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If a Flow strip flickers near the controller, cut the power and check the controller plug. If the flicker comes back, the controller is replaced under warranty."},{"chunk_id":"kb_ctrlheat01","quote":"If the controller body is hot to the touch, unplug the strip at once and do not switch it on until it has been checked."}]}}
